method: For each sync, sweep enclosing full-duration cpu_op/user_annotation intervals on the identical pid/tid. Independently match External id to enclosing CPU op and device events, and match each copy's correlation to a CUDA runtime event inside that CPU op. Durations are host API durations in microseconds. Range totals count all enclosing annotations; groups use the innermost annotation. No input shapes are inferred.
